title: bls12-381-g1-ecdlp: additive Cheon v32 (prime class lists, exact energy decomposition, the residual's strata certified by the row sieve, both moment premises ladder-measured)

claims.statement: For the protected BLS12-381 G1 target with auxiliary powers and every n with 2^20 <= n < r, the deterministic algorithm in proof.md recovers s with heuristic success probability at least 0.390 (at least 0.39 required). The success argument is the exact distinct-index energy decomposition E = 6*sum s(s-1) + E_{k!=0} (the diagonal belongs to E+N), with the mixed-root k=0 term proved EMPTY by the cutoff-free 15-pair Omega-equality certificate, shared-prime rho = +/-1 wrapped collisions excluded under the retained 2*X1^2*X2 = 2^235 < r (the r = 481,153 counterexample), repeated coordinates bounded at 2.671e-19 of the birthday baseline B0, and the residual covered by PRIORITY strata, every structured piece PROVED at production under P1 (delta^w <= 500, measured 0.678-8.49 at three scales) with NO H2: the >=2-common-small, pruned INNER and all multiple-common-prime configurations together at 1.091872e-8 independent of P1/H2 (norm-dual-joint.txt), the SAME-SIDE exactly-one-shared-small stratum at 0.156980 of B0 by the finite direct-row lattice-line sieve (exact rational upper 0.15697936430584272, under P1 and the certified .57/.64 block endpoints, actual class and prefix weights, no H2 list-size cap - finite-sieve-alternative.txt), which REPLACES the earlier Selberg majorant and its unbounded signed remainder R_SS without bounding it, the exactly-one-shared-large lattice theorem at 0.002332911916573675, two common larges at 1.64e-17 (exact 1.6330900757069875e-17), and the coprime main 36*M0/m <= B0 with the nonpositive correction dropped conservatively. The known pruned excess is ledger-stated 0.159313 (exact 0.1593122871411313), and the claim is the DETERMINISTIC route-B fourth-Bonferroni floor on the pruned multiset: |S|/m >= kappa + g(kappa) - (1 + known + Delta0/B0)*K^2/2 >= 0.3900083 at the NAMED coprime premise Delta0/B0 <= 53/1250 = 0.0424 (exact maximal 0.04245561919460539), floor-stated 0.390 >= 0.39, conditional on P1, the ladder-measured P3/P4 and the ladder-supported coprime premise. The P3/P4 ladder (canonical record: p34-campaign-report.txt, in-folder; every figure recomputed by the run from embedded raw records): seven exact swap-pruned ratio-occupancy controls (d = 2^4..2^20, normalized by the actual retained mean kappa = T0/h) all satisfy both bounds, and three 64-stratum output-character HT estimates at the production d = 2^20 with the exact original prefixes put the bounds 11.9-16.5 (P3) and 13.7-19.0 (P4) design SEs inside the measurements, the joint gain J34 = F3/6 - F4/24 sitting 25.0-37.6 SEs above its premise boundary (exact covariance retained; each selected bin keeps its FULL occupancy, inclusion probability s/L for every k). Design-unbiasedness and the variance/covariance algebra are proved by exhaustive finite oracles; the strata were preregistered before the outputs; an independent stdlib replay matched a full stratum exactly; the measurements sit ON the quantitative Cartesian hypergeometric null. SEs are design sampling uncertainty at the fixed targets only; the 35-bit X2/d gap, geometry gaps and PRNG idealization remain explicit; P3/P4 stay named premises. The premise is supported - not proved - by the collaborator's measurement ladder (measurement_campaign_report.md, in-folder; every consuming figure recomputed by the package's own run from embedded raw records): seven exact finite controls (quartic and C3 families, d = 2^4..2^20, production full49 rule, all measured Delta0/B0 in [-1.03e-3, +3.83e-5]), three design-unbiased whole-row Horvitz-Thompson targets at the production d = 2^20 with the ACTUAL production character masks and the original unpruned full-critical prefix rule (X2/d = 2^7/2^11/2^15, six preregistered seeds each; design-unbiasedness proved by exhaustive small-sample oracles; measured means -0.00457/+0.00970/+0.00753, empirical SEs 0.00921/0.00407/0.00923, the allowance 3.8-8.0 SEs above), one exact dense low-load complement. The 35-bit X2/d gap (2^15 vs 2^50), the ~182.3-bit field-size gap and the tier/block-width geometry gaps are disclosed; no confidence interval, no uniform modulus/character bound, and no original-total P2(0.057) claim is made (the unpruned total at the premise exceeds 0.20). Route A is retired (0.3747 at Delta0 = 0). The certificate code ships in evidence.py as ONE compressed VERBATIM image (the exact bytes of shared_large_certificate.py, direct_row_sieve_verify.py and norm_dual_joint_verify.py - the route-B pair with standalone-output tails removed, the v30 convention), executed FRESH by the run in isolated namespaces, with the identically-named in-folder files as the auditable canonical copies whose byte-identity the run asserts when present and whose executed texts' sha256s it reports; prime_count_inputs.py ships in-folder (stdlib, runnable) supplying the Dusart transcription spot-checks; the hosted runner stages only evidence.py, and a single-file foreign-cwd execution reproduces every block byte-identically. The only external analytic input is Dusart arXiv:1002.0442v1 Thm 6.9 eq (6.6), stated with validity domains in prime-count-dependency.txt and transcription-checked against independent sieves; the full derivations (shared-large-derivation.txt, finite-sieve-alternative.txt, norm-dual-joint.txt) are in-folder. The U-filter identity is verified exactly at both energy points; the law's calibrated null test, the structured-lambda point, the probe/shard check and the end-to-end toy attack all run and pass in the same experiment. Score = log2(W(2^20)) = 116.958777 (exact 116958777/1000000, rounded up; the cost ledger is identical to v28's), against the track frontier 116.982765. Preprocessing <= 2^115.968, included in W. Peak memory <= 2^122.9 bytes. No advice. Reads only A_1 and A_{2^20}.

experiments.purpose: One run with six parts. (1) Recomputes the cost ledger at K = 0.55 (canonical y 30, hash 240, bookkeeping 100; every charge asserted above its itemised count), the exact score, the preprocessing output, the PROVEN prime-availability interval lower bound (Rosser-Schoenfeld) and the shared-class-prefix lost-value bound. (2) The production certificates: the constant structure (L = x^2 - 1 with L^2 + L + 1 = r exactly; the six U-representatives as polynomials with their orders), the cutoff-free 15-pair mixed-root certificate, D_repeat, the retained 2*X1^2*X2 < r with the r = 481,153 counterexample, and the two swap bounds. (2b) The production route-B certificates: the four collaborator modules (prime_count_inputs.py, shared_large_certificate.py, direct_row_sieve_verify.py, norm_dual_joint_verify.py) embedded in evidence.py as ONE compressed VERBATIM image (byte-identity to the in-folder copies asserted when present, executed texts' sha256s reported), executed FRESH in isolated namespaces since the hosted runner stages only this file: the direct-row sieve (same-side shared-small), the norm-dual inner/multi bound, the shared-large lattice theorem, the two-large/repeated corrections, the pruning loss, the ledger bound 0.159313, and the conditional route-B floors as exact functions of the NAMED coprime premise; the Dusart lemma stated with validity domains and transcription spot-checks. (2c) The coprime measurement ladder: seven exact finite controls, three whole-row HT targets at the production d = 2^20 with the actual production character masks and the original unpruned full-critical prefix rule, and one exact dense low-load complement - raw records embedded as exact integers, every consuming fraction (Delta0/B0, theta, means, empirical SEs) recomputed from the raw counts, allowance margins reported descriptively. (2d) The P3/P4 measurement ladder: seven exact swap-pruned ratio-occupancy controls and three 64-stratum output-character HT estimates at the production d = 2^20 with the exact original prefixes - raw records embedded as exact integers, every consuming figure (F3/kappa^3, F4/kappa^4, design SEs, J34 margins) recomputed from the raw counts. (3) The law's calibrated null test at two scales (the v28 experiment, extended with the exact energy decomposition, per-order family rates and class-marginal second moments). (4) The structured-lambda cyclotomic point r = 48^4 - 48^2 + 1: full energy decomposition, family rates, class moments and the exact coverage count. (5) hash_probe: 16,384 structured walk keys, 16 shards at load 1/2. (6) The end-to-end toy attack on a 24-bit j = 0 curve with d = 2^6 under the production block rule, 16 fixed-order and 40 shuffled trials, every recovered scalar asserted correct.
